atf:
@obverse
$ (beginning broken away)
1'. [{giš}na-mul-lum] : na#-[mul-lu]
#tr.en: "[@i{Namullu}] = @i{plank} bed";
2'. [{giš}ŠITA₂] : kak-ku : GI : qa#-[nu-u]
#tr.en: "[@i{Šita}] = weapon"; "@i{Gi} = reed";
3'. [{gi}GUR].HUB₂# : hup₂-pu : DUG : kar#-[pa-tu₄]
#tr.en: "[@i{Gurh]ub} = large basket"; "@i{Dug} = earthenware";
4'. [{d}AMAR?.UTU?] zik-ri DINGIR-MEŠ :!?# {d}AMAR#.[UTU ...]
#tr.en: "[(When) @i{Marduk} (heard)] the word of the gods"; "Mar[duk ...];
// L I.2 SB "V" 1
5'. [{mul?}]APIN PAB an-ni-u₂ IM.G[ID₂?.DA? (x)]
#tr.en.(o 6'): [@i{Mul}] @i{Apin}: all these tablet[@i{s}] (exist) in three copies.
#note: in the light of BM.36374:1 it seems more likely that the beginning of this line should be restored as follows: [ITI].APIN; the text compositions mentioned make up that month's scribal pensum for the named individuals. [HS]
6'. ša 3#-šu₂-nu {m}du-gul-IGI-[DINGIR]
7'. {m}ki-ṣir-aš-šur ki-lal-le-šu₂-[nu]
#tr.en.(o 8'): Dugul-pan-[@i{ili}] and Kiṣir-Aššur are both copying @i{Urra}.
8'. UR₅.RA : i-šaṭ-ṭu-ru#
9'. u₂-ba#-aš₂-šim man-za-za [(ana DINGIR.DINGIR)]
#tr.en: "He created stations [(for the great gods)"];
// L I.2 SB "V" 1
10'. {d}[AMAR.UT]U zik-ri DINGIR-MEŠ# [(ina še-mi-šu₂)]
#tr.en: "[(When) Mardu]k [(heard)] the words of the gods"
#note: @i{Pace} Parpola, probably not Enlil, see  the incipit of Ee VI [TM] (see Lambert (Folio) who had already noted this).
// L I.2 SB "VI" 1
11'. [{d}asar-re ša₂-rik me₂-reš-ti (ša₂ is-ra-ta u₂-kin-nu)]
#note: Tentative restoration, compare the two preceding lines [TM]
// L I.2 SB "VII" 1
$ (rest broken away)
@reverse
$ (beginning broken away)
1'. e?#/dug?# [x x x x x]
2'. na-mar-k[u-u x x x x]
#tr.en: behind schedu[le ......]
3'. IM.GID₂.DA-[(MEŠ?) x x x x x]
#tr.en: one-column tablet[(s) ......]
4'. a-ta-mar n[a? x x x x (x x)]
#tr.en: I @i{saw} ... [......]
5'. ina pa-ni-i[a x x x (x x)]
#tr.en: at m[y] disposal [......]
6'. DUB#-MEŠ x [x an?]-ni?# [x (x)]
#tr.en: tablets [......]
7'. [(x x) x x] aš₂-ṭ[u?-ru?/ur?]
8'. [x x x x] b[u? x x (x)]
$ (rest broken away)
